note: Names, descriptions and grades are shown exactly as PlayStation publishes them. Every guide below is written in our own words from the official description alone: no specific location, count or step is claimed unless the official description states it, and where the description names no exact place the guide says so plainly.

trophies.guide: This is the platinum, so there is nothing separate to do for it: it unlocks automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned. Work through the roadmap in order, story first and collectibles last, and use the tracker in this app to see which trophies are still missing. Save it for last; it is the final check that the whole list is done.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.roadmap_note: Stage 5: the platinum is the last trophy by definition, earned only after every other trophy on this list.

trophies.roadmap_note: Missable rule: missable=true only where the official description binds the trophy to a single unrepeatable moment — here, a second attempt after a first failure. Keep a manual save before attempts you might fail.

PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

steps: Keep a manual save before an attempt you might fail
Fail the attempt once
Succeed on the second try to unlock the trophy

trophies.guide: Witness something strange in the world — the description is a reaction, not an instruction, so the exact event is not stated in the official description. Because no single place or moment is named, it is not flagged missable: keep exploring Leonida and the event should trigger when you find it. The guide here deliberately claims no step the description does not support.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

steps: Explore Leonida in free roam
Watch for strange events as you play
Trigger the event to unlock the trophy

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone over with a melee drive-by: strike from a moving vehicle with a melee weapon, bowling them over as the description says. Drive-bys can be tried again any time in free roam, so nothing here can be missed. The official description names no exact place, so find a pedestrian in the open, drive past and land the melee hit from the vehicle.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

steps: Get a melee weapon and a vehicle
Drive past a target in the open
Land the melee hit from the moving vehicle

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder Marked Bills through your contacts until you have earned $250,000 from it: the count is cumulative, so it builds up over many launderings. Laundering can be repeated, so nothing here can be missed. The official description names no specific contact or rate, so keep laundering Marked Bills through your contacts until the total reaches $250,000.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

steps: Collect Marked Bills
Launder them through your contacts
Keep going until $250,000 is earned

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across the game's shops: every purchase counts toward the one total, in any shop. Spending can be done any time, so nothing here can be missed. The official description names no specific shops, so buy what you need — weapons, clothes, vehicles — across shops until the total reaches $100,000.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

steps: Visit shops in the world
Buy items across different shops
Reach $100,000 spent in total

trophies.guide: Buy every garage property the game offers: each one counts, and the trophy unlocks when the last one is purchased. Properties stay available to buy, so nothing here can be missed. The official description states no count of garage properties and no list of them, so save up, find each garage property on offer and buy them all.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

steps: Earn money for property purchases
Find a garage property on offer
Buy it, then repeat until all are purchased

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 different vehicles to the Scooter Bros app: each vehicle counts once, so ten distinct registrations are needed. Vehicles keep appearing across Leonida, so nothing here can be missed. The official description names no vehicle list, so find vehicles, register each one in the Scooter Bros app and repeat until 10 are registered.
trophies.name: On the Spot

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

steps: Find a vehicle you have not registered
Register it to the Scooter Bros app
Repeat until 10 vehicles are registered
